logic.bm: 電力機器事業: 受変電・配電用機器 and 監視制御システム・制御機器 (manufacture, sale, installation) — extra-high-voltage 受変電設備 plants built around large transformers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), disconnectors (断路器), distribution equipment; mainly for TEPCO Power Grid and other Japanese utilities plus industrial/social-infrastructure plant customers. Other segments: 計量 (smart meters, instrument transformers), GX solutions (EV quick chargers "SERA"), optical inspection (3D semiconductor inspection). Seasonal: power-equipment sales concentrate in Q4 (Jan–Mar).
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

structural_breaks.note: 事業管理区分変更: 計器事業→計量事業 (part of 電力機器 moved to 計量). FY2016 電力機器 recast in FY2017 filings (FY2016 full year 56,417→52,244; Q1 12,186→11,215). FY2017 points carry recast FY2016 prior_year_comparative; FY2016 points keep as-reported values with same-basis FY2015 comparatives.
Mechatronics moved from エネルギーソリューション to 情報・光応用検査機器 (電力機器 unaffected).
日本リライアンス (80%) and its subsidiary RAS sold; deconsolidated from Q3 FY2017 (エネルギーソリューション segment).
Accounting change (not a restatement): 収益認識会計基準 adopted; 有償支給 transactions now net → FY2021 consolidated sales −1,228m vs old method; prior year not restated.
エネルギーソリューション renamed ＧＸソリューション and absorbed 情報機器 (from Q2 FY2022); 電力機器 unaffected (FY2021 電力機器 57,664 printed unchanged).
